parallels.note: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”
They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce, and divorce her?”
translations.bsb: “Why then,” they asked, “did Moses order a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?”
translations.kjv: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
translations.asv: They say unto him, Why then did Moses command to give a bill of divorcement, and to put her away?
